payload.content: Perplexity MCP server configured in ~/.hermes/config.yaml: command=npx, args=-y @perplexity-ai/mcp-server. Enabled. Requires PERPLEXITY_API_KEY in ~/.hermes/.env and mcp pip package. Tools appear as mcp_perplexity_*. Use for web searches when available. Restart Hermes (/reset) after key changes.
